subject: Campus access & demo itinerary — finalizing visit logistics
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Amy Chen <amy.chen@falkenhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Campus access & demo — proposed dates and prep

Hi Amy —

Great to hear Falken is able to visit Redwood next week. Wanted to propose a quick on-site demo and ops sync so we can review the integration checklist and a short Q&A with our infra team. Proposed slots (PST):

- Wed 2026-11-18, 10:00–11:30
- Wed 2026-11-18, 14:00–15:30
- Thu 2026-11-19, 09:30–11:00

Two quick asks so we can prepare:
1) Can you share the final attendee list (full names + photo IDs) for building access?
2) We require a simple NDA for visitor-level access — I can send a DocuSign link.

We have Conference Room A3 reserved as a tentative space; will confirm once you lock a slot. Parking: Guest lot P2 (on arrival, get a temporary badge at reception).

If a time above works, reply with preferred slot and attendees and we'll send the DocuSign and visitor form.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com | +1 (510) 555-0183
[Attachment: Redwood campus directions v2.pdf]

From: Amy Chen <amy.chen@falkenhealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Falken Onsite Team <onsite@falkenhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 11:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Campus access & demo — proposed dates and prep

Marcus —

Thanks for the quick note. We prefer Wed 11/18 at 14:00–15:30 PST. Attendees:

- Amy Chen (amy.chen@falkenhealth.com) — Director of Product
- Ravi Patel (ravi.patel@falkenhealth.com) — Staff Engineer
- Elena Ortiz (elena.ortiz@falkenhealth.com) — Security Manager

We'll need the NDA and a visitor spreadsheet for security. Two notes from our side: Elena will want to confirm that no laptops are put on guest network by default and whether you provide a dedicated VLAN for demo hardware. Also, can you accommodate an extra 30 minutes after the session for a quick ops debrief with Redwood infra (if engineers are available)?

Please send the DocuSign NDA and I'll route to procurement — we aim to have signed copies by EOD Tuesday.

Best,
Amy
Amy Chen
Director of Product, Falken Health
amy.chen@falkenhealth.com

Hi Amy —

Thanks — locking Wed 11/18 14:00–15:30 PST and reserving A3 + a follow-up ops slot 15:30–16:00 for an infra debrief.

Attached is the Visitor NDA (DocuSign link below) and a visitor intake sheet for security. Please complete the intake sheet with full legal names and government ID types so the reception team can pre-print badges.

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/link/ABC123def
Visitor intake (CSV): [Attachment: demo-visitor-list-template.csv]

Subject: Re: Campus access & demo — proposed dates and prep

Amy —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. We received the signed NDA this morning — thanks. Final logistics below for Wed 2026-11-18: 

Arrival & check-in
- Please arrive at Redwood reception (1200 Redwood Blvd) by 13:45 to allow time for badge printing.
- Bring a government photo ID for each visitor.
- Guest parking: Lot P2 (follow signs from Redwood Blvd).

Schedule (Conference Room A3)
- 14:00–14:10 — quick introductions + agenda
- 14:10–15:00 — product demo (Marcus + Karthik)
- 15:00–15:30 — hands-on infra walkthrough (Grace)
- 15:30–16:00 — ops debrief / Q&A (Grace, infra leads)

Security & network
- Elena: we will provision a restricted demo VLAN for demo devices; laptops will not be connected to corporate internal subnets by default. If you need VPN/external log access, let us know and we can pre-provision time-limited credentials.

Attachments included:
- Visitor NDA - Falken Health (signed).pdf
- Campus directions v2.pdf
- Demo room A3 schedule.csv

If anything changes on your side (additional guests, flight delays), ping me on my cell and we'll adjust. Looking forward to hosting you.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com | +1 (510) 555-0183
